definition.name: quantum_channel
definition.definition: A quantum channel Phi is a completely positive, trace-preserving (CPTP) linear map between spaces of density matrices. Equivalently, Phi(rho) = sum_k K_k rho K_k^dag where {K_k} are Kraus operators satisfying sum_k K_k^dag K_k = I. The diamond distance between channels Phi, Psi is ||Phi - Psi||_diamond = max_{rho} ||(Phi tensor id)(rho) - (Psi tensor id)(rho)||_1.
